brief:
A resistance source disclosed details of arresting three individuals, including a woman, during an attempted abduction of a central political or military figure in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The arrests took place as the suspects allegedly moved to execute the kidnapping operation against the unnamed target.

The resistance source provided no additional information regarding the identities of those detained, their alleged roles or affiliations, or the precise timing of the security operation. No statement was issued concerning the status or whereabouts of the intended abductee, or whether the plot had progressed beyond the planning stages before authorities intervened.
